title: Kolibri: A Sovereign European Model on the Pareto Frontier
abstract: arXiv:2610.31945v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This report introduces Kolibri, an English-German mixture-of-experts transformer with 78.1B total parameters and 3.46B active parameters per token, released as open weights under the Apache 2.0 licence. We built Kolibri for sovereign and specialised deployment, with a particular focus on German and on regulated domains such as public administration, industry, and aerospace. To support these settings, we control the full model-development process, including data, architecture, training infrastructure, post-training, and evaluation.   We train Kolibri on 24T tokens across pre-training, mid-training, and long-context extension, with German accounting for more than 20% of the data mix by bytes. To reach this share, we complement German datasets with more than 2T German tokens that we curate from the web with our own pipeline and generate synthetically. translated_title: Kolibri：位于帕累托前沿的欧洲主权大模型
translated_abstract: 本报告介绍了Kolibri，一个英德双语的混合专家transformer模型，总参数量为78.1B，每个token激活3.46B参数，以Apache 2.0许可证开源发布。我们构建Kolibri的目的是实现主权化和专业化部署，特别关注德语以及公共管理、工业和航空航天等受监管领域。为支持这些应用场景，我们掌控了完整的模型开发流程，包括数据、架构、训练基础设施、后训练和评估。我们在24T token上对Kolibri进行训练，涵盖预训练、中期训练和长上下文扩展，其中德语按字节数计算占数据组合的20%以上。为达到这一比例，我们通过自建数据管道从网络整理并合成生成了超过2T的德语token，以补充德语数据集。后训练阶段将在精选的德语和英语数据上进行监督微调与……（摘要原文不完整）
tldr: Kolibri是一个总参数78.1B、激活参数仅3.46B的英德双语开源混合专家模型，通过完全自主掌控的数据与训练流程实现德语占比超20%（含2T自建德语token）的训练，在帕累托前沿上实现了面向主权化部署的高效性能。
en_tdlr: Kolibri is an open-weight English-German mixture-of-experts model with 78.1B total and 3.46B active parameters, trained on 24T tokens with over 20% German data (including 2T self-curated German tokens), achieving Pareto-frontier performance for sovereign and specialised deployment.
